title: 6.3 Where Are You Going?
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Ask about a current destination and answer with I am, you are, he/she is and we/they are going.
grammar_function: Ana is leaving for the mall. Luis asks her destination. They then talk about a man going to the bank and a woman going to the library. Finally, Ana’s family joins her: we are going to the mall, while an outside observer describes the same group as they. Every question is followed by the answer it requests.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Ask about a current destination and answer with I am, you are, he/she is and we/they are going.
